name: Minecraft (Bedrock Edition)
description: A Minecraft Bedrock server for console, mobile and Windows players. Current Bedrock releases accept players over NetherNet: a handshake over TCP and gameplay over UDP, both on port 19132, which is published directly because the HTTP proxy can carry neither.

access.note: A Bedrock server has no web sign-in: players join from a console, phone or Windows client at your host on port 19132, TCP and UDP. The port is published on loopback until you choose every interface under Runtime and allow it through the firewall. As shipped the allow list is off and nobody is an operator, so any Xbox-Live-authenticated player who learns the address and port can join and build in your world.

provenance.updateNotes: The image is pinned; the Bedrock server build is resolved at deployment and recorded on the release.
